Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.

-Recovers 30 Cost for all allies.
-Reduces the Cost of all enemies by 25.
-Casts despair on all enemies for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Casts frenzy on your character for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6500
